changelog: v2.0: obsidian and royal-gold control center with responsive configuration and per-account planning.
Updated Home and Builder Battle-menu entry with in-menu army preparation and direct Find Match / Find Now handoff.
Faster boat navigation and Builder camera preparation with bounded gestures instead of repeated terrain corrections.
Both village boat cameras allow a second drag only when the first has not exposed the boat; cart collection shares this bounded camera.
Faster standard ADB raw capture with PNG fallback, shared frame checks, and bounded parallel popup matching reduce repeated startup work.
Shared Home and Builder Build-panel wall entry restores the horizontal controls before existing gem-safe upgrades.
Wall affordability now reads cost digits without mistaking red-brown hammer artwork for an unaffordable price.
Updated Home and Builder resource HUD regions and shared complete-digit matching fix clipped balances and false digit ambiguity while retaining two-frame agreement.
Global watchdog handles known blocking popups, Welcome Back readiness, disconnects, and inactivity recovery.
Home event rewards and chest opening flow through verified controls before returning to the village.
Clearer dashboard activity for accounts, army preparation, popup recovery, wall entry, and collection.
Troop Requests is temporarily disabled in every edition and marked Update Pending; saved request-only accounts are skipped.
Portable signed updates preserve configuration and license files.
